about: BioShock drops you into rapture, andrew ryan's failed objectivist city at the bottom of the atlantic, and hands you plasmids and firearms in equal measure. The loop is immersive-shooter craft - hacking turrets, camera-researched damage bonuses, adam economy and little sister choices - and splicer chatter plus audio diaries carry one of gaming's most quoted scripts to its would-you-kindly twist.

2K boston and 2K australia shipped it in august 2007, and the steam listing is the current official pc door, still carrying a price. The 2007 build remains the real pc version - the 2016 remaster rides the same store page as a separate executable, which makes the original the archive-truth build this page documents.

The 2007 build runs comfortably at the haswell igpu bar for 720p-900p settings, with dx10 extras above it. The status box carries the honest state: not-tested until a real run confirms install, launch, patches and saves.
